identification: Six matching Victorian (George Routledge and Sons, London) pocket-size 'Poetical Works' volumes in full tan calf, gilt tooled spines with red labels: Milton, Scott, Works of Charles Lamb, Goldsmith etc, Longfellow, Wordsworth (Wordsworth illustrated by Birket Foster). Harrow School prize binding: front boards stamped with gilt crossed arrows crest (Harrow), a Harrow prize label in the first volume ('Harroviensi diligentiae praemium', handwritten for Gallicus/French, dated around A.S. MDCCCLXXIX or 1878-9 per catalogue), marbled edges. Bindings are the value, as a prize set, not the texts, which are common Routledge reprints.
